evidence:
Static structure supports graded reward, but the required empirical reward-discrimination measurement is missing. Workbook quality check 40 and its Internal Quality Checks counterpart (both Excel row 41, no extra internal annotation) require a spread across partial-quality apps; frozen skill references/quality-checks.md:165-166 specifically warns against collapsed signal. Frozen task tests/scoring.toml:1-12 matches the frozen template: functional/polish/visual weights 0.6/0.2/0.2, zero-weight gates and functional floor 0.05. tests/tools/score.py:40-48 aggregates dimension scores after gates/floor, rather than returning one binary result. Parsed criterion structure is 86 independently weighted binary functional rows (total weight 45), 14 polish rows (weight 9), and six anchored five-point visual rows (weight 6). The functional prompt:9 preserves completed observations and calls for equivalent minimal setups after a failed prerequisite; polish/visual prompt:6 also require independent scoring. The constraints gate explicitly stops at saved pending creation and fresh-context readback, leaving approval separate. Thus no static all-or-nothing collapse is established.

Available actual local witnesses are useful but do not grade the apps. In local/witnesses/golden.json, W-FIT approves 200/COMMITTED, W-OVER is refused 409, and remaining budget is 2000000 cents. In budget_disabled.json the same overrun approves 200/COMMITTED and budget becomes -1000000, while intrinsic/run-rate/band/lineage/signing vectors remain successful. In dead_approval.json all approval attempts return 409, and positive-control-aware budget/stale checks correctly remain false despite raw refusal. local/gate-witness/results.json shows both golden and dead-approval apps satisfy the measured pending-create/readback prerequisite while a no-op create app does not. These observations are consistent with useful independent credit, not measured reward values. SUMMARY.json:161 expressly says no configured-judge reward discrimination/ranking evidence and no scores computed; the driver:90-112 records HTTP vectors, not RewardKit results. The raw evidence index also labels its contents supplementary local evidence. runtime-evidence.json is absent. qc/README.md:27 and qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md:31 require a hash-bound actual reward-discrimination runtime record; this cannot be waived by source reasoning or finite HTTP assertions.

Verified frozen hashes against manifest for cited workbook, skill, references, template policy/scorer, task policy/scorer, gates, scored rubrics/prompts and instruction. Verified witness source hashes against all 11 frozen solution files. Cited artifact hashes match raw-evidence-index.json: SUMMARY ce485c90950d3d980f9a2a6feac771978215a13877dbbd42dd1dee546bc33a03; golden 9c5e23a769bcd8a4df902a0dfdb0dcf37d869c32cac6e93d26a3ca261f0f4037; budget_disabled 964e46764364c2d24f5dbc79e5c6747e3b59455f7bf59327574f592e728bbd2d; dead_approval f394539d577cc58483b954dbe60200a991061675187202e62547413651d4ed32; gate-witness results fd8410bc91102874ef98edfdbacf19f7853687956e076acc684d36c565d9ec75; witness driver ab9887a79fa81afdd7533675c574a7b42b1a016307a2736a61dbfaf82bad11a4. No new provider/Docker run was performed.
counterexample: Stress tests considered, not demonstrated configured-judge misgrades: a dead-approval app can pass the basic shared-storage prerequisite and should retain valid composition/creation credit while losing approval outcomes; a budget-disabled app should retain unrelated formula/lineage credit while losing budget enforcement. Conversely, a conforming alternative that uses separate detail pages or ordinary independent controls after an unrelated scenario failure should not lose every criterion; the prompts explicitly permit these alternatives. Actual configured rewards for these apps are unavailable, so neither their spread nor absence of reward collapse is established.
suggested_fix: When provider execution is authorized, run the unchanged configured verifier on the reference and multiple partial-quality variants, retain actual per-criterion/dimension/final rewards and failures, and add the hash-bound reward_is_graded_not_binary_and_discriminates runtime record for this input. Investigate any collapse without changing shared scoring policy to manufacture discrimination.
